annotations.title: Get enterprise buying windows & F500 pilot programs (Why Now)

description: Enterprise buying windows & Fortune 500 pilot desks (Why Now intelligence). Returns macro replacement cycles (SAP ECC 2027, VMware cliffs, CMS mandates) and active venture-client RFP programs across Retail, Healthcare, and Manufacturing. Name a company in `query` to also get its dated public buying signals: hiring and tech stack from public job boards, partners and marketplace listings, enterprise customers named on vendors' own sites, conference speaker lineups, podcast guest appearances by its executives, and newsletter sponsorships. Company-level only, each with its source link and date seen.

query.description: Optional keyword or buyer name, e.g. 'Walmart', 'SAP', 'supply chain', 'clinical'

sector.description: Optional target sector: retail, manufacturing, healthcare, education, or horizontal

signal_type.description: Optional: one kind of public buying signal

window_type.description: Filter by buying window type. public_signal = only the company's public buying signals (needs query)
